author: Arnav
problem: starts lists the page each chapter of a book begins on, in order, and the book's last page is last_page. Return how many pages each chapter has.
bug_description: Takes a chapter's end as the next chapter's start page instead of the page before it, so every chapter except the last is one page too long.

comments.accurate: Counts the pages in each chapter; the last chapter runs to the end of the book
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts each chapter's pages through the page where the next chapter opens
comments.wrong_location: Chapter ends verified; check the length formula end - start + 1
